create_nfsp_agent: create a Neural Fictitious Self-Play agent with JAX for reinforcement learning in games
build_reservoir_buffer: build a reservoir buffer that allows uniform sampling over a stream of data using reservoir sampling
run_nfsp_step: run the NFSP agent step to select an action based on best response or average policy mode
save_nfsp_checkpoint: save the NFSP agent's average policy network and Q-network to a checkpoint directory
restore_nfsp_checkpoint: restore the NFSP agent's average policy network and Q-network from a checkpoint directory
